snippet.title: Valheim: Call to Arms - Official Trailer | gamescom 2025
snippet.description:
Join Ulfar and see his feats of bravery (and some brutality) in this latest Valheim trailer for the exploration and survival game for 1-10 players. Valheim is set in a procedurally-generated purgatory inspired by Viking culture. Battle, build, and conquer your way to a saga worthy of Odin’s patronage! Valheim: Call to Arms is available now for public testing.

#IGN #Gaming #gamescom2025
